description:
At Simple Technology Solutions, our people are our priority. We know our team members are more than employees—they’re parents, friends, volunteers, artists, and athletes. That’s why we offer flexibility to help them thrive personally and professionally while delivering exceptional solutions to our Federal Government clients. 

 Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence. We are mentors and thought leaders who share knowledge and foster growth. Recognized as a “Best Place to Work,” we believe a range of perspectives helps us drive innovation and exceed customer expectations. At STS, taking care of our people isn’t a perk—it’s the standard. 

 As a HUBZone company, we also offer special incentives for team members living in qualified HUBZones. Check out the HUBZone map  HERE to see if you qualify! 

 Quick Position Overview: 

 
 US Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance are required

 Bachelor's Degree is required

 Minimum of 8 years' position related experience is required

 AWS Certified AI Practitioner or Developer (Associate) certification preferred for hire; the AWS and Anthropic Claude certifications listed under Required Certifications must be earned within 12 months of hire

 Remote position with occasional travel to client sites and STS events

 Candidates living in the DC Metro region (within driving distance for quarterly in-person team events) are strongly preferred; STS is a HUBZone company, so residence in a HUBZone is favored for remote candidates

 
 The Role: 

 The AI Quality & Test Engineer owns the second human bookend of the STS SDLC: proving that what the team built does what the requirements say, works end to end for real users, and behaves acceptably as an AI system. You design the test strategy from the requirements trio, build and run end-to-end and user-acceptance testing, and define how AI outputs are evaluated so that quality is measured rather than assumed. Success looks like test gates the team trusts, defects found before users do, and clear evidence at every release that the solution meets its acceptance criteria. You bring the same discipline to engagements that run on AWS-native AI services or other client toolchains.

 The AI Quality & Test Engineer at STS will: 

 
 Define the test strategy for each AI application project from the requirements trio, including unit, integration, end-to-end, user-acceptance, security, and AI-behavior testing, and the coverage and gate thresholds the project will use.

 Design, build, and execute end-to-end and user-acceptance tests that exercise complete use cases as real users would, across DEV, TST, STG, and PRD.

 Build evaluation harnesses for AI behavior, including golden datasets, rubric-based and model-assisted grading, regression suites for prompts and retrieval, and guardrail and safety checks.

 Operate as the tester in the team's AI development workflow, using and improving the shared testing agents and skills, and ensuring tests derived from use cases exist before application code is written.

 Automate tests in the CI/CD pipeline in partnership with the platform engineer, and own the quality gates that govern promotion between environments.

 Validate acceptance criteria with the business analyst and real users, facilitate user-acceptance testing sessions, and capture results as release evidence.

 Triage, reproduce, and track defects in Jira, drive them to resolution with engineers, and analyze defect trends to improve upstream requirements and development practices.

 Test on AWS-native AI stacks, including Amazon Bedrock models, agents, and knowledge bases, when a client requires them in place of STS's standard toolchain.

 Assess performance, cost, and resilience of AI features under realistic load and failure conditions, and report findings with recommendations.

 Contribute test standards, templates, and tooling back to the STS SDLC, and coach the team on test-driven development and AI evaluation practices.

 
 Education and Experience: 

 Required 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience in addition to the minimum below

 Minimum of 8 years of software quality engineering or test automation experience, including at least 2 years testing applications built on large language models or other AI/ML components

 Demonstrated experience building automated end-to-end test suites integrated into CI/CD pipelines and defining quality gates for a delivery team

 Experience leading user-acceptance testing with business or mission users, ideally in a federal or regulated environment

 Strong test automation skills in Python or TypeScript using frameworks such as Playwright, pytest, or Jest, plus API testing tools

 Practical knowledge of LLM evaluation techniques, including golden datasets, rubric and model-graded evaluation, retrieval quality metrics, and prompt and model regression testing

 Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock and AWS application services sufficient to test and troubleshoot deployed AI features

 Fluency with GitHub, Jira, and CI/CD pipelines, and with reading use cases and specifications to derive tests

 Familiarity with security testing basics and federal compliance expectations for test evidence

 Skeptical in the best sense; assumes nothing works until it is demonstrated, including AI output that reads well

 Collaborative and constructive, treating defects as information for the team rather than blame

 Self-directed and comfortable owning outcomes on a small, senior team where everyone contributes across the lifecycle

 Curious and current on AI tooling; treats AI assistants as part of the team and holds their output to the same standard as human work

 Clear, candid communicator with federal clients and teammates; writes well and documents as a habit

 Bias toward fast delivery and early user feedback over conservative gating; learns from failure quickly

 
 Required Certifications (to be earned within 12 months of hire) 

 
 AWS Certified AI Practitioner or AWS Certified Developer – Associate

 Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (CCDV-F) or Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (CCAO-F)

 
 Preferred Certifications 

 
 ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) and ISTQB Certified Tester AI Testing (CT-AI)

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate

 CompTIA Security+

 Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM I)

 
  

 What We Offer: 

 
 Competitive compensation package

 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans

 Professional development and training

 Performance-based incentives

 401(k) retirement savings plan

 Work from home stipend

 Unlimited PTO

 Paid holidays

 Flexible work schedule

 Professional development budget to be used for training and certifications

 STS is committed to equal employment opportunity and merit-based employment practices. STS provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination, harassment, and retaliation in all employment practices and decisions in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

 
 Employment decisions at STS are based on individual qualifications, performance, skills, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, or any other status protected by applicable law. 

 
 This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, compensation, training, transfer, discipline, termination, layoff, recall, and leaves of absence. 

 --- 

 Applicants may request removal from our applicant database, or specific information about how the data is used by contacting recruiting@simpletechnology.io.
